result:
Comments, deleting, reporting and auto-hiding are in, and `bun run typecheck` passes. I didn't boot the app, run the test suite or apply the migration, so none of the behaviour has been exercised.

- **Storage:** `comments` and `comment_reports` are added in `db/schema.ts`, with a unique index on (`comment_id`, `user_id`). The generated migration is `db/migrations/20261019152519_comments`.
- **Models and files:** New `Comment` and `CommentReport` models, a `CommentResource` and a `CommentValidator` (body 1–2000 characters, trimmed, so it fails the way an invalid post title does).
- **`CommentController`:**
  - **`POST /posts/:id/comments`** stores the comment with the signed-in user as author and redirects to `/posts/:id`.
  - **`DELETE /comments/:id`** lets the comment's author or the post's author delete it and redirects to the post. Anyone else gets 403.
  - **`POST /comments/:id/report`** always answers 204 and only counts the first report per user.
  - **Guests:** all three routes sit behind the existing `auth` middleware, so guests are redirected to `/login`.
- **Post page:** `PostController.show` now passes `comments`, oldest first. A comment with three or more distinct reporters is left out of the page but stays in the table.
- **Post deletion:** `PostController.destroy` deletes the post's comments and their reports itself, because SQLite only enforces the foreign-key cascade when `foreign_keys` is on.
- **UI:** `posts/Show` has a comment list with author and time, a comment box, Delete where the viewer is allowed, and Report.
- **Signed-in check:** The page decides whether you're signed in from `props.auth.user`, as the existing Edit and Delete buttons do. The project rules say that prop is undefined unless `shareInertiaProps()` is called, so the comment box and buttons may not show in a browser until that's confirmed.
